operations.description: Specify exact finite/infinite horizons and outputs without dropping empty or infinite input sequences
operations.old: The root, addition, and division in the update are coordinatewise.
operations.new: For a finite gradient sequence of length $T\ge0$, perform rounds $1\le t\le T$ and return the trajectory $(x_1,\ldots,x_{T+1})$; when $T=0$, return $(x_1)$. For an infinite gradient sequence, perform every round $t\ge1$, thereby defining and returning the iterate sequence $(x_t)_{t\ge1}$. The root, addition, and division in the update are coordinatewise.

operations.description: Specify finite-horizon trajectory output; preserve all existing recurrence/denominator conventions

operations.new: Return the trajectory $(x_1,\ldots,x_{T+1})$, whose final iterate is $x_{T+1}$. The denominator parameter is added inside the square root. No moment bias correction is applied.
